brief: Review a synthetic VJ controller spec. Its Pulse action temporarily moves an effect to the opposite endpoint from its current target, then returns to the saved baseline. Repeated pulses preserve that original baseline. A newer manual level or latch action cancels the pulse. Musical Hold pauses parameter motion, but pulses must still complete and the beat counter must advance. Downbeat resets phrase phase and actually aligns drive phases; pending quantized actions keep their remaining musical delay. Give at most five concrete edge-case tests with numeric inputs and expected outcomes. JSON only; no implementation or generic advice.
